summary: Verified Box external-source folder-recursion bug fix. All 4 new tests in test_box_recursive_sync.py pass (nested files pulled, empty-tree surfaces actionable last_error, default folder_id='0', recursion respects 100-file cap). 12-test regression suite (admin invite + preview images) still passes. Live regression as mira against the preview Composio API confirms the new slug + recursion code path reaches Composio: with a fake ConnectedAccount the source row's last_error contains 'No connected account found ... for toolkit box' (Composio ConnectedAccountNotFound), proving sync executed end-to-end through the new recursion branch. Cleanup verified — throwaway source row deleted from mongo after the test.
action_items: Redeploy backend to production (app.nextcapos.com) so the user's AZpme listing benefits from the recursion fix — confirmed working on preview.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 9677 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting external-source sync (lines 4985-5180) and Box-specific recursion into a dedicated module (e.g. backend/integrations/box_sync.py) to improve maintainability and testability.

MAX_DEPTH=4 and MAX_TOTAL=100 are hardcoded in the recursion block. Consider promoting these to module-level constants or env vars so they can be tuned without code edits if a seller has very deep Box hierarchies.

The recursion uses subfolders.pop(0) on a list — that's O(n) per dequeue. For large trees this could matter; collections.deque would be a one-line upgrade. Functionally correct for the current 100-file cap though.
Diagnostic last_error wording on the empty-tree path is good and seller-actionable ('no downloadable files found ... pick a specific subfolder'). Nice.
seed_data_creation: Live test created a temporary listing_external_sources row on listing 2c0ec79b-... and deleted it after assertion. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Box recursion fix is verified working on preview. test_box_recursive_sync.py (4 tests) is the canonical regression for this code path — re-run after any change to _run_external_source_sync (server.py 4985-5180). The Composio path is exercised via mocks in pytest and via a fake ca_fake connected_id in /tmp/test_box_live.py for live smoke. Production deployment to app.nextcapos.com is the pending step.
rca of the issue: Iter-27 added a `type != 'file'` filter to defensively drop non-file entries returned by the renamed BOX_LIST_ITEMS_IN_FOLDER slug. Box's root folder normally contains only subfolders, so the filter silently dropped every entry → 0 files staged, 0 errors logged. Fix: when source_kind=='box', BFS-recurse into subfolders (depth-limited to 4, total file cap 100), classify entries by type (folder→requeue, file→keep), and when pulled==0 surface a seller-actionable last_error mentioning 'no downloadable files' so the failure mode is no longer silent. Verified via 4 mocked unit tests + 1 live Composio smoke.
